newsitem.title: USA: Miami air cargo rises 10.68 percent in November.
newsitem.headline: Miami air cargo rises 10.68 percent in November.

text.p: Cargo at Miami International Airport continued its strong winter growth, gaining 10.68 percent in November, according to airport statistics obtained by Reuters.
All cargo, including mail, moved through MIA in November totaled 174,546 tons, up 10.68 percent from the same month of 1995, according to statistics compiled by Metro-Dade Aviation Deaprtment.

The gains were led by an 11.33 percent jump in international cargo. International freight amounted to 142,058 tons in November. Domestic cargo totaled 32,488, up 7.89 percent compared with November of 1995.
These increases bring MIA's total cargo, including mail to 1,720,692 tons for the first 11 months of the year. Mail amounted to 76,821 tons.
